name: Eris

skills.name: Puppet's Advent
skills.description: Eris unleashes a shot at the weakest enemy, dealing 200% ATK as DMG. Commands all puppets to synchronize fire for additional DMG equal to 300% of their ATK per shot.

upgrades.level2: Eris's shot deals 300% ATK as DMG.
upgrades.level3: Each Puppet shot deals bonus DMG equal to 7.5% of the target's lost HP (up to 600% of the puppets ATK).
upgrades.level4: Eris's shot deals bonus DMG equal to 15% of the target's max HP (up to 500% of Eris's ATK).

skills.name: Secret Strands
skills.description: Unleashes a shot to deal 100% DMG to the target and summons a Puppet for 30s. Puppets: Inherit 20% of Eris's ATK and Max HP. Puppets cannot move or act independently; instead they assist Eris's Normal Attacks regardless of distance, dealing 100% of their ATK as DMG. Max 3 Puppets.

upgrades.level2: Puppet: Inherits 30% of Eris's ATK and Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Each of Eris's Normal Attack reduces this skill's CD by 0.5s.
upgrades.level4: Puppet: Inherits 60% of Eris's ATK and 30% of Max HP.

skills.name: Requiem of Strings
skills.description: Upon the defeat of any non-puppet ally (including Deitys and Minions), summons 1 puppet at their position (Passive). Max 3 puppets, each lasting 25s. Puppet: inherits 60% of Eris's ATK and 30% max HP.

skills.name: Puppet Sacrifice
skills.description: Upon taking Lethal DMG, Eris becomes untargetable for 3s. CD: 30s.

upgrades.level4: When Eris secures a kill, this skill's CD is reduced by 7.5s.

relic.name: Curse of Puppets
relic.description: Eris marks an enemy, ignoring 30% of the target's DEF when she and her puppets deal DMG (passive).

upgrades.level3: Summons puppets upon the defeat an enemy Deitys.

strengths: Unique DPS amplification: each additional Puppet multiplies total output. More Puppets = higher burst ceiling on every Ultimate cycle.
Passive Puppet generation from ally deaths. Gains power precisely when a team is under pressure, inverting the normal carry disadvantage.
Built-in survivability through Puppet Decoy death-dodge. Exceptional durability for an Archer class.
DEF penetration relic applies to all active Puppets simultaneously. 90% DEF ignore at max relic amplifies the entire Puppet swarm.
Relic Lv3: enemy Deity deaths trigger Puppet summoning. Potential snowball in PvP where both teams are losing units.
Missing/Max HP damage on Ultimate at Skill 1 Lv3–4. Effective against tanky high-HP targets.
weaknesses: Requires Puppet buildup time. Without accumulated Puppets, Eris is a below-average Archer.
Fast burst compositions end fights before Puppet stacks and death-triggers accumulate.
Puppet inheritance starts at 20% ATK (Skill 2 base). High Skill 2 upgrade investment required to reach damage ceiling.
Maximum Puppet count gated behind Skill 4 upgrade levels (3 → 5 → 7).
Puppet Decoy has a 30s base cooldown. In repeated burst matchups, the dodge may not be available for every lethal threat.
